shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a suite-styled mod-settings page in parity with the Modules window, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field. `Palette.ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight` = shared full-width settings row (label + right-side switch + optional measured/wrapped dim description; whole row is the click target) used by both settings surfaces. Also `DrawCard`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.** `Patch_CheckOpenLogWindow` suppresses auto-open while `ProgramState.Entry`; still auto-opens in-game; manual open always works.
- **Toolbar B buttons (right→left):** Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, **Knowledge base** (`MDT_KbButton`, opens `Window_KnowledgeBase`), then the search field fills the rest.

### Benign "no concern" classification
Normal no-fault vanilla log lines classified via `KnownIssueDef.benign` (curated in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml`). `KnownIssueIndex.HasBenignMatch(ctx)` runs before the module loop (only when `msg.type != Error`), sets `ctx.Benign`; while set, `ErrorContext.Merge` no-ops all attribution. Inspector shows a green "No concern" badge, forces impact to Info, hides the report card.

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by `Score`. Modules: `Module_StackTrace`, `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, `Module_HarmonyPatches`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_Glossary`.
- **Index prewarm** (`Bootstrap` → `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` off-thread). Harmony index built lazily on first analysis.
- **Harmony patch-owner attribution** (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`): reverse-maps `"Type.FullName:Method" → owner-id[]`. Diagnosis when ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace. Self excluded.
- **Proactive dependency & load-order scan** (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, order 60): mirrors vanilla `GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts`.
- **Plain-language glossary** (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `DrawSection`, order 900).

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
Two **distinct** layouts sharing the `Palette` visual language; internal rule documented in `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` + checklist comments on `ModernDevToolsSettings`, `SettingsPage`, and `Dialog_Modules`.
- **`ModernDevToolsSettings`** — all user-facing settings: `moduleEnabled`, `ignoredIssues`, `enableCommunityData`, `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`, `experimentalWindowHardening`, `experimentalMapUiHardening` (+ internal `lastSeenVersion`).
- **Mod-settings page (`SettingsPage.Draw`, canonical superset)** — replaced the old clipped `Listing_Standard`/`CheckboxLabeled` page. A single scrolling column of suite cards: **General** (auto-open toggle), **Analysis modules** (intro + full module list with provenance tags + toggles), **Ignored warnings** (Clear all + Remove rows / empty state), **Community data** (enable toggle + Update info + status), **Experimental hardening** (2 toggles). Reserves the 16px scrollbar gutter unconditionally and sizes every rect by measurement (`Text.CalcHeight`/`Palette.ToggleRowHeight`) so descriptions never clip and there's no reflow flicker; `_lastHeight` feeds next frame's viewRect. `DoSettingsWindowContents` is now a one-liner into `SettingsPage.Draw`.
- **Modules & filters window (`Dialog_Modules`, quick-access subset)** — opened from the log's Modules button. Left: module list; right: ignored warnings + community data; bottom: hardening. `SourceTag`/`CommunityStatus` are `internal static` here and reused by `SettingsPage` so the two surfaces can't drift on tags or status.
- **The rule:** anything exposed on the Modules window must also be reachable from the settings page; the settings page is the superset.

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
Source-agnostic reference browser for everything the mod knows, independent of any selected error. Suite chrome (`doWindowBackground=false`, `Margin=>0`), left rail of 8 categories + right searchable content pane; every entry cites provenance. Tabs: **Sources** (dashboard with live status + inline community-data control), **Known issues**, **Benign log lines**, **Community bugs** (our DB + `ModShippedIssues`), **Compatibility** (scoped to installed/active mods: About incompat, community RimSort rules, Use This Instead replacements), **Dependencies** (`ModDependencyIndex.All`), **Harmony patches** (lists every patched method with resolved patcher(s); `ForeignCount >= 2` = amber conflict candidate, sorted top; capped 300), **Glossary**. Read-only accessors on `CommunityData`/`HarmonyIndex`/`Glossary` feed it.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (PUBLIC, live). Offline snapshot ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz`.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less composer; destination hierarchy: culprit mod's GitHub → its Workshop page → community Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a → `[#xxxxxxxx]`. `ReportBuilder.FullReport` flattens an error's analysis to text.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph; adds category "Modern Dev Tools" with test-log/exception actions (all `Anywhere`-gated). Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid. Esc steps up one level; hides the dev palette while open; whole-tab BFS search (time-boxed, focus deferred one frame).

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`. Resolves pinned nodes from `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette`. Nested breadcrumb paths; auto-fit size.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) on focus changes, NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). Settings keys incl. `MDT_SettingsGeneral`, `MDT_SettingsIntro`, `MDT_NoMainMenuLog(+Desc)`, `MDT_Section*`, hardening `MDT_*Short`/`*Desc`, community `MDT_Comm*`. Knowledge-base keys `MDT_Kb*`.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked; `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored.
